hooks.command: bash -c 'tool_input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$tool_input" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "^\\s*git\\s+commit\\b"; then exit 0; fi; transcript_path=$(echo "$tool_input" | jq -r ".transcript_path // \"\""); if [ -z "$transcript_path" ] || [ ! -f "$transcript_path" ]; then echo "Run /probertson-review:self-review before committing." >&2; exit 2; fi; prior=$(grep -n "\"command\":\"git commit" "$transcript_path" | sed \$d | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); start=${prior:-0}; if tail -n +$((start+1)) "$transcript_path" | grep -qE "probertson-review:self-review|/probertson-review:self-review"; then exit 0; fi; echo "Run /probertson-review:self-review before committing." >&2; exit 2'
